kind: SPECIFICATION ONLY; native fixtures/driver not implemented
isolation_fixture_rule: All destinations/proxies/control planes disposable, inside verified boundary. Never use live V2Ray listener or real OpenAI.
counts_rule: Blocked specifications are NOT collected/passed/skipped transport tests.

cases.title: positive explicit-proxy baseline
cases.trigger: Each applicable control-plane/MCP HTTP/Harpoon path reaches an owned origin through its pinned fixture proxy.
cases.oracle: Correlate physical proxy forward socket with origin peer; component marker required.

cases.title: proxy port unavailable
cases.trigger: Keep an owned port reserved but not listening; use exact native endpoint/config after source review.
cases.oracle: No origin request, no direct native dial; concrete Windows error observed, not guessed.

cases.title: CONNECT refusal
cases.oracle: Observed CONNECT marker and native failure; no origin/direct fallback.

cases.title: proxy timeout
cases.trigger: Fixture accepts CONNECT then withholds response within bounded harness timeout.
cases.oracle: Fault phase reached; retries/dials stay on pinned proxy, all workers reap.

cases.title: success then disconnect
cases.trigger: First request forwards; subsequent proxy accepts close mid exchange.
cases.oracle: Only first expected origin request; every later attempt remains proxied.

cases.title: retry and reconnect
cases.trigger: Inject repeatable refusal/disconnect with bounded observation budget.
cases.oracle: Record actual native attempt count/backoff/error chain; never infer retries from elapsed time alone.

cases.title: origin redirect
cases.trigger: First origin redirects to another owned loopback fixture, same/different authority cases.
cases.oracle: Apply actual native redirect policy; every allowed hop remains pinned; prohibited hop returns exact error.

cases.title: proxy CONNECT redirect
cases.trigger: Proxy returns 302 with owned local Location.
cases.oracle: Record reject/follow semantics and route of any follow-up; no unobserved direct connection.

cases.title: explicit proxy versus NO_PROXY
cases.trigger: Child-only NO_PROXY/no_proxy: *, loopback IP, synthetic hostname; conflicting ambient HTTP(S)_PROXY.
cases.oracle: Explicit route remains pinned per bundled documented contract; inspect all relevant bindings.

cases.title: ambient environment behavior
cases.trigger: No explicit proxy, finite child-only HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY/NO_PROXY cases.
cases.oracle: Characterize documented ambient bypass separately; direct-by-design is not mislabeled automatic fail-closed.

cases.title: DNS and address families
cases.trigger: Literal loopback proxy, synthetic .invalid target handled by fixture mapping, IPv4/IPv6 controls.
cases.oracle: Observe native resolver/dial attempts under enforced containment; no system DNS change or external lookup.

cases.title: component and per-server override
cases.trigger: Controlled global/component/per-channel/env:VAR conflicts, empty and missing references.
cases.oracle: Derive exact expected precedence/errors from matching source; detect any default/direct route, do not assume from flag help.

cases.title: OAuth discovery and redirects
cases.trigger: Fake resource/auth metadata, timeout/retry and trusted-origin redirect cases.
cases.oracle: Native endpoint contracts must be derived from exact source; no real credentials/issuer/token service.

cases.title: Harpoon targets
cases.trigger: Owned local HTTP target/discovery and additional-transport configuration branches.
cases.oracle: Every applicable callout observed; disabled paths asserted; no real registration.

cases.title: proxy-health background checks
cases.trigger: Bounded local configured routes and each proxy failure phase.
cases.oracle: Distinguish health bookkeeping from actual dial and fallback; observe all native sockets.

cases.title: companion and child paths
cases.trigger: Controlled configuration proving optional Cloudflared/extra transports disabled.
cases.oracle: No companion process or hidden remote connector; no companion binary delivered to guest.

cases.title: SOCKS5 URL validation
cases.trigger: Provide socks5/socks5h URLs only in the isolated native parser/config path.
cases.oracle: Observe exact rejection/acceptance and zero network activity; compiled stdlib SOCKS code alone is insufficient.

cases.title: TLS trust failure
cases.trigger: Untrusted disposable TLS origin through CONNECT; no system trust-store edits.
cases.oracle: Native TLS rejection with no direct retry; expected fixture reset distinguished from unexpected errors.
